description: This source file defines a pipeline behavior class for handling database transactions within an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR. It ensures that each request is wrapped in a database transaction, committing on success and rolling back on failure.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions, wrapping request handling in a transaction scope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the request within a transaction, committing if successful and rolling back if an exception occurs.
